annotations.title: Install or Update Game Server Mod

description: Install a mod from the gameserver's mod browser (find it with list_gameserver_mods: provider + projectId). Also updates, downgrades or repairs an installed mod: pass the versionId (see check_gameserver_addon_updates). Without versionId the newest compatible version is installed. Rust uMod plugins are mods with provider "umod" (set_gameserver_rust_framework to oxide first). The server must be stopped. Requires confirm=true. Returns an operation (get_operation_status) and the installationId. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.
